plan.description: A collaborative productivity platform for teams to manage projects, track tasks, log time, and visualize progress through kanban boards and analytics dashboards.
core_features: Project creation with milestones, deadlines, and owner assignment
Task management with assignee, priority, due dates, and kanban status flow (Backlog → In Progress → Review → Done)
Team member invitation and role-based access control
Time tracking per task with start/stop timers and manual entry
Real-time activity feed showing recent task updates and time logs
Analytics dashboard with project velocity, burndown charts, and individual productivity stats
future_features: Calendar integration (Google, Outlook)
Slack and email notifications for task changes
Custom workflow templates per team
Advanced reporting with export to CSV/PDF
Mobile app for iOS and Android

milestones: Task CRUD with kanban status flow
